_what: What Chairy says when you press it. One is chosen at random.
_sources: Every saying carries the page it came from, read out of the Knowledge System mirror's own frontmatter rather than typed from memory. A saying with a 'credit' is NOT ours and says so aloud when Chairy speaks it — the furniture cites its sources, which is this site's habit rather than an exception to it.
